hints: Double-click install.exe. Then drag the dial slowly until the static clears.
When the hum is clean it plays four notes. The taller the bar, the higher the note. Play them back in the same order.
Missed it? PLAY AGAIN hums the four notes again. A wrong note starts you over from the first.
your scan from the 27th is still on the drive. read it.
two numbers answered with a tone. listen before you dial. a fax chirps in bursts. a modem holds one long note.
only one of those tones is a machine that wants to talk to a modem.
you can't see your room from the screen. look around.
maya trusted you with something. it's on the desk.
things have two sides. turn it over.
the public pool won't take a login. you wrote a staff line down somewhere in this room.
look at the numbers taped near the monitor. turn them over.
you have the line. the name and the secret word are where maya left them.
read the back of her photo again. every letter matters.
the printer forgets things. printers keep what they can't finish.
stuck jobs wait in a spool, and the spool keeps a log.
one job is being held. find where held jobs are kept.
